examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava.
moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhār'ūpamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.

15501.grammar: fut, reflx 1st sg of upaññissati, trans (+acc)
15501.meaning1: I myself will explain; I will teach

examples.text: moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, dukkaraṃ durabhisambhavaṃ, handa te naṃ pavakkhāmi, santhambhassu daḷho bhava.
moneyyaṃ te upaññissaṃ, khuradhār'ūpamo bhave, jivhāya tālum'āhacca, udare saññato siyā.
pānīya-paribhojanīya-upaṭṭhapanañ'ca, chand'ārahānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chand'āharaṇañ'ca, tesaññ'eva akat'uposathānaṃ pārisuddhiyā'pi āharaṇañ'ca

15503.meaning2: attendance; having (someone) served or cared for

15504.meaning2: (also upaṭṭhāpeti, upaṭṭhapeti) brings near, provides; procures, fetches; makes serve or attend, employs; causes to appear, brings about

15505.meaningLit: to cause to be stood near

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa pariṇāyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati, paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upaṭṭhapetabbaṃ upaṭṭhapetuṃ apayāpetabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ. so rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āha, app'ossukko tvaṃ, deva, hohi.
āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.
tassa sāvakā na sussūsanti, na sotaṃ odahanti, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhapenti, vokkamma ca satthusāsanā vattanti.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasantassa sākete kiñci'd'eva accāyikaṃ karaṇīyaṃ uppajjeyya. tassa antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.

15508.meaning1: causes to attend (to); gets (a doctor) to treat

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, mālukyaputta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhapalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhapeyyuṃ.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño cakkavattissa pariṇāyakaratanaṃ pātubhavati, paṇḍito byatto medhāvī paṭibalo rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upaṭṭhapetabbaṃ upaṭṭhapetuṃ apayāpetabbaṃ apayāpetuṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ ṭhapetuṃ. so rājānaṃ cakkavattiṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āha, app'ossukko tvaṃ, deva, hohi.

15510.meaning1: having set up; having made sure (something) is present
15510.commentary: (DNa) parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā'ti kammaṭṭhān'ābhimukhaṃ satiṃ ṭhapayitvā. mukhasamīpe vā katvā'ti attho. ten'eva vibhaṅge vuttaṃ, ayaṃ sati upaṭṭhitā hoti sūpaṭṭhitā nāsik'agge vā mukhanimitte vā, tena vuccati parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā'ti (vibha. 537). athavā parī'ti pariggah'aṭṭho.

examples.text: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā
tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.

15511.meaning1: having placed at hand; having put ready; having set out

examples.text: upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santh'āgāraṃ santharitvā āsanāni paññapetvā udakamaṇikaṃ upaṭṭhapetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

15512.meaning1: having established; having set up; having caused to attend; having caused to be present
15512.meaning2: having established; having set up; caused to attend; to be present
15512.commentary: (THIa) cittaṃ upaṭṭhapetvānā ti bhāvanācittaṃ kammaṭṭhāne upaṭṭhapetvā. (THIa) satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvānā ti satipaṭṭhānabhāvanāvasena kāy'ādīsu asubha-dukkh'ānicc'ānatta-vasena satiṃ suṭṭhu upaṭṭhitaṃ katvā.

examples.text: yathā kaṇṭakaṭṭhānamhi, careyya anupāhano, satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvāna, evaṃ gāme munī care.
satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvāna, bhikkhunī bhāvit'indriyā, paṭivijjhi padaṃ santaṃ, saṅkhār'ūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ.

15513.meaning1: establishing; setting up; causing to be present
15513.meaning2: establishing; setting up; causing to attend; to be present

examples.text: cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahanto sikkheyya, saddhāya adhimuccanto sikkheyya, vīriyaṃ paggaṇhanto sikkheyya, satiṃ upaṭṭhapento sikkheyya
etassa me antarā ca sāvatthiṃ antarā ca sāketaṃ satta rathavinītāni upaṭṭhapesuṃ.
app'ekacce maṃ paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesuṃ, app'ekacce āsanaṃ paññapesuṃ, app'ekacce pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhapesuṃ. api ca kho maṃ nāmena ca āvusovādena ca samudācaranti.

15515.commentary: (MNa) viditā uppajjantī'ti uppajjamānā viditā pākaṭāva hutvā uppajjanti. viditā upaṭṭhahantī'ti tiṭṭhamānā'pi viditā pākaṭāva hutvā tiṭṭhanti. viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchantī'ti nirujjhamānā'pi viditā pākaṭāva hutvā nirujjhanti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno viditā vedanā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti, viditā saññā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti, viditā vitakkā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti.
ty'āssa dhammā viditā uppajjanti, viditā upaṭṭhahanti, viditā abbhatthaṃ gacchanti. so evaṃ pajānāti, evaṃ kira'me dhammā ahutvā sambhonti, hutvā paṭiventī'ti.

so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti. tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya. so upaṭṭhaheyya pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
aññena ca kevalinaṃ mah'esiṃ, khīṇ'āsavaṃ kukkuccavūpasantaṃ, annena pānena upaṭṭhahassu, khettaṃ hi taṃ puññapekkhassa hotī'ti.

15517.meaning2: waits or attends on, cares for, nurses

examples.text: sace āyasmato channassa n'atthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi. mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmā'ti.

15520.commentary: (MNa) padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsū'ti padhān'atthāya pesit'attabhāvaṃ vasanaṭṭhāne pariveṇasammajjanena pattacīvaraṃ gahetvā anubandhanena mukh'odaka-dantakaṭṭha-dān'ādinā ca upaṭṭhahiṃsu.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhave, etadahosi, bahukārā kho me pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū, ye maṃ padhānapahit'attaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu. yaṃnūn'āhaṃ pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyan'ti.
annena pānena upaṭṭhahimhā, pād'ūpasaṅgayha sake nivesane, kutomukhā nāma ime bhavanto, buddhassa dhammāni paṭiggahesuṃ.
atīte kira kassapasammāsambuddhakāle gāmavāsī eko kuṭumbiko ekassa therassa vihāraṃ katvā taṃ tattha viharantaṃ catūhi paccayehi upaṭṭhahi

15524.meaning1: is nursed; is looked after; is cared for (by)

15525.meaning1: being nursed; being looked after; being cared for (by)

examples.text: tam'enaṃ ñātakā upaṭṭhahanti paricaranti. so ñātakehi upaṭṭhahiyamāno paricariyamāno ten'eva ābādhena kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti.

tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu ca sāmaṇero ca gilānaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃsu. so tehi upaṭṭhahiyamāno kālam'akāsi. atha kho tassa gilān'upaṭṭhākassa bhikkhuno etadahosi, kathaṃ nu kho gilān'upaṭṭhākassa sāmaṇerassa cīvarapaṭivīso dātabbo'ti?

15526.meaning2: stands near, stands by; places oneself by; presents oneself; is present, appears; stands near in order to serve, serves, attends (plus accusative, occasionally plus dative/genitive); tends; worships

examples.text: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto sāmaṃ sen'āsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkāmi
etu kho āyasmā ānando! svāgataṃ āyasmato ānandassa bhagavato upaṭṭhākassa bhagavato santik'āvacarassa!
sace āyasmato channassa n'atthi patirūpā upaṭṭhākā, ahaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ upaṭṭhahissāmi. mā āyasmā channo satthaṃ āharesi. yāpet'āyasmā channo, yāpentaṃ mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ icchāmā'ti.
so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, na labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, na labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmato sāriputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa santike dārakaṃ pāhesi, imaṃ dārakaṃ thero pabbājetū'ti.

15530.meaning1: family of followers; family of devotees; supporting family

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena āyasmato sāriputtassa upaṭṭhākakulaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa santike dārakaṃ pāhesi, imaṃ dārakaṃ thero pabbājetū'ti.
atha kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca, atthi nu kho, bhante, añño koci mayā upaṭṭhākataro'ti?

15532.commentary: (ANa) gilān'upaṭṭhākīnan'ti gilān'upaṭṭhākīnaṃ upāsikānaṃ, suppiyā upāsikā, aggā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhākīnaṃ yadidaṃ suppiyā upāsikā.

15533.meaning1: should be attended to; should be nursed

examples.text: imaṃ kho, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca gilānabhattaṃ anuññātaṃ gilānabhesajjaṃ anuññātaṃ gilān'upaṭṭhāko anuññāto. imañ'ca pana, bhikkhave, gilānaṃ paṭicca aññe'pi gilānā upaṭṭhātabbā.

tassa taṃ vanapatthaṃ upanissāya viharato anupaṭṭhitā c'eva sati na upaṭṭhāti, asamāhitañ'ca cittaṃ na samādhiyati, aparikkhīṇā ca āsavā na parikkhayaṃ gacchanti, ananuppattañ'ca anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ n'ānupāpuṇāti.

15536.meaning2: waits or attends on, cares for, nurses, serves

examples.text: nappaṭibalo hoti bhesajjaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ, sappāy'āsappāyaṃ na jānāti, asappāyaṃ upanāmeti, sappāyaṃ apanāmeti, āmis'antaro gilānaṃ upaṭṭhāti, no mettacitto, jegucchī hoti uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā vantaṃ vā kheḷaṃ vā nīharituṃ…

15538.meaning2: to stand near; to be present

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho, ānanda, kikī kāsirājā kassapaṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etadavoca, adhivāsetu me, bhante, bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ vass'āvāsaṃ, evarūpaṃ saṅghassa upaṭṭhānaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
mātāpitu upaṭṭhānaṃ, puttadārassa saṅgaho, anākulā ca kamm'antā, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

15545.meaning2: having the manifestation of placing oneself near; having the appearance of establishing oneself

15547.commentary: (ANa) upaṭṭhānasāran'ti upaṭṭhānena sāraṃ, idaṃ varaṃ idaṃ niṭṭhā'ti evaṃ upaṭṭhitan'ti attho.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca, sabbaṃ nu kho, ānanda, sīlabbataṃ jīvitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ upaṭṭhānasāraṃ saphalan'ti? na khv'ettha, bhante, ek'aṃsenā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhū pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ sannisinnā sannipatitā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ anuyuttā viharanti
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti
lakkhaṇ'ādīsu ca tesaṃ tesaṃ dhammānaṃ sabhāvo vā sāmaññaṃ vā lakkhaṇaṃ nāma, kiccaṃ vā sampatti vā raso nāma, upaṭṭhān'ākāro vā phalaṃ vā paccupaṭṭhānaṃ nāma, āsannakāraṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ nāma.

15552.meaning2: producing, bringing about; arranging attendance; having (someone) served or cared for

15553.meaning2: brings near, provides; procures, fetches; makes serve or attend, employs; causes to appear, brings about

examples.text: kudāssu nām'āhaṃ tadāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharissāmi yadariyā eta'r'ahi āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharantī'ti iti anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpayato uppajjati pihapaccayā domanassaṃ.
sabbasanthariṃ santhataṃ, bhante, santh'āgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni, udakamaṇiko upaṭṭhāpito, telappadīpo āropito. yassa'dāni, bhante, bhagavā kālaṃ maññatī'ti.

15556.meaning1: should be established; should be set up; should cause to be present; should make sure one has
15556.meaningLit: to cause to be stood near

examples.text: kālena vakkhāmi no akālena, bhūtena vakkhāmi no abhūtena, saṇhena vakkhāmi no pharusena, atthasaṃhitena vakkhāmi no anatthasaṃhitena, mettacitto vakkhāmi, no dos'antaro'ti, ime pañca dhammā ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetabbā
atha kho āyasmato sāriputtassa etadahosi, bhagavatā paññattaṃ, na ekena dve sāmaṇerā upaṭṭhāpetabbā'ti.

15557.meaning2: should be cared for; should be attended to
15557.meaningLit: to cause to be stood near

15558.meaning1: who makes (someone) serve them; who appoints an attendant

examples.text: asīti me, āvuso, vassāni pabbajitassa n'ābhijānāmi sāmaṇeraṃ upaṭṭhāpetā

15559.meaning2: provides, procures, puts forth, causes to be present or waits on

examples.text: idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññapeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti

15560.meaning1: establishes; sets up; causes to be present; makes sure one has

examples.text: no ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno mettaṃ cittaṃ paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti sabrahmacārīsu anāghātaṃ, tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā sabrahmacārīsu mettaṃ cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpehī'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
āneñjapaṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

15561.meaning1: gets (a doctor) to treat; makes attend (to)

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sunakkhatta, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷh'ūpalepanena. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.

rūpānaṃ tv'eva aniccataṃ viditvā vipariṇāmavirāganirodhaṃ, pubbe c'eva rūpā eta'r'ahi ca sabbe te rūpā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā'ti evam'etaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā anuttaresu vimokkhesu pihaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti

so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anuddayaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anukampaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhāpeyya, aho vat'āyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, labheyya gām'antanāyakaṃ!

15563.commentary: (VIN 2.5.7.10) upaṭṭhāpeyya vā'ti tassa cuṇṇaṃ vā mattikaṃ vā dantakaṭṭhaṃ vā mukh'odakaṃ vā sādiyati (VINa) upaṭṭhāpeyyā'ti tena attano upaṭṭhānaṃ kārāpeyya.

examples.text: so taṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, upaṭṭhaheyyaṃ taṃ, bhante'ti. tam'enaṃ so gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upaṭṭhāpeyya. so upaṭṭhaheyya pubb'uṭṭhāyī pacchānipātī kiṃkārapaṭissāvī manāpacārī piyavādī.
yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ tathānāsitaṃ samaṇ'uddesaṃ upalāpeyya vā, upaṭṭhāpeyya vā, sambhuñjeyya vā, saha vā seyyaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.

15564.meaning1: to set up; to establish; to make sure is present

examples.text: cha, bhikkhave, ānisaṃse sampassamānena alam'eva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ. katame cha?

15565.meaning1: having set up; having made sure is present

examples.text: na kho, ānanda, sukaraṃ paresaṃ dhammaṃ desetuṃ. paresaṃ, ānanda, dhammaṃ desentena pañca dhamme ajjhattaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo. katame pañca?
tena sammatena bhikkhunā pariveṇaṃ sammajjitvā pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpetvā āsanaṃ paññapetvā dutiyaṃ gahetvā nisīditabbaṃ.
atha kho, bhikkhave, bandhumā rājā vipassissa kumārassa tayo pāsāde kārāpesi, ekaṃ vassikaṃ ekaṃ hem'antikaṃ ekaṃ gimhikaṃ, pañca kāmaguṇāni upaṭṭhāpesi
atha kho āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca nandiyo āyasmā ca kimilo bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā, eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññapesi, eko pād'odakaṃ upaṭṭhāpesi.

yaṃ, bhikkhave, sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya diṭṭhaṃ sutaṃ mutaṃ viññātaṃ pattaṃ pariyesitaṃ anuvicaritaṃ manasā, tam'ahaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ. taṃ tathāgatassa viditaṃ, taṃ tathāgato na upaṭṭhāsi.
upāsikā cakkhumato ahosiṃ, nāmam'pi mayhaṃ ahu gopikāti, buddhe ca dhamme ca abhippasannā, saṅghañ'c'upaṭṭhāsiṃ pasannacittā.
sati kāyagatā upaṭṭhitā, chasu phass'āyatanesu saṃvuto, satataṃ bhikkhu samāhito, jaññā nibbānam'attano'ti.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, saṃvaro hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso

15572.commentary: (SNPa) bhattakāle upaṭṭhite'ti bhojanakāle jāte. upaṭṭhitan'ti'pi pāṭho, bhattakāle āgatan'ti attho.

examples.text: yo brāhmaṇaṃ samaṇaṃ vā, bhattakāle upaṭṭhite, roseti vācā na ca deti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

15573.meaning1: stuck to; devoted to; applied oneself to

examples.text: sīl'uttamā saññamen'āhu suddhiṃ, vataṃ samādāya upaṭṭhitāse, idh'eva sikkhema ath'assa suddhiṃ, bhav'ūpanītā kusalā vadānā.
sa piṇḍacāraṃ caritvā, van'antam'abhihāraye, upaṭṭhito rukkhamūlasmiṃ, āsan'ūpagato muni.

15574.meaning1: with body awareness present; attending mindfully to the body

examples.text: so cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe na sārajjati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso. tañ'ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti, yatth'assa te pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.

15575.meaning1: with body awareness present; attending mindfully to the body

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe n'ādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na byāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyassati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso

15576.meaning1: with presence of mind; attending mindfully

examples.text: upaṭṭhitasatissa-ayaṃ dhammo n'āyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhasatissa

15578.meaning1: with presence of mind; attending mindfully
15578.commentary: (MNa) upaṭṭhitā sati etesan'ti upaṭṭhitassatī, niccaṃ ārammaṇ'ābhimukha-ppavatta-satīnam'etaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (ANa) upaṭṭhitassatissā'ti catusatipaṭṭhānavasena upaṭṭhitassatissa.

examples.text: tasmā hi dhīro idh'upaṭṭhitassatī, kāme ca pāpe ca asevamāno, sahā'pi dukkhena jaheyya kāme, paṭisotagāmī'ti tam'āhu puggalaṃ.
ye pana te kulaputtā… āraddhavīriyā pahit'attā upaṭṭhitassatino sampajānā samāhitā ek'aggacittā paññavanto aneḷamūgā, tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

15579.meaning1: fact of having presence of mind; state of attending mindfully

examples.text: etam'ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, upaṭṭhitassatitaṃ attani sampassamāno bhiyyo pallomam'āpādiṃ araññe vihārāya.
kusītassa purisapuggalassa vīriy'ārambho hoti parikkamanāya, muṭṭhassatissa purisapuggalassa upaṭṭhitassatitā hoti parikkamanāya, duppaññassa purisapuggalassa paññāsampadā hoti parikkamanāya
tathāgatassa tattha hatthināgena upaṭṭhiyamānassa vasanabhāvo sakalajambudīpe pākaṭo ahosi

15583.meaning2: stands near, stands by; places oneself by

15585.meaning2: stands near in order to serve, serves, attends; tends; worships

15586.meaning2: standing near, standing by; placing oneself by; presenting oneself; being present, appearing; standing near in order to serve, serving, attending (plus accusative, occasionally plus dative/genitive); tending; worshipping

examples.text: yathā nāma, bhante nāgasena, atibhārena sakaṭassa akkho bhijjati, atibhārena nāvā osīdati, atibhuttena bhojanaṃ visamaṃ pariṇamati, ativassena dhaññaṃ vinassati, atidānena bhogakkhayaṃ upeti, atitāpena pathavī upaḍayhati, atirāgena ummattako hoti, atidosena vajjho hoti, atimohena anayaṃ āpajjati…
ty'āhaṃ evaṃ vadāmi, api pana tumhe āyasmanto ekaṃ vā rattiṃ ekaṃ vā divasaṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā rattiṃ upaḍḍhaṃ vā divasaṃ ek'antasukhiṃ attānaṃ sañjānāthā'ti?
aho vat'āhaṃ tadantaraṃ jīveyyaṃ yadantaraṃ upaḍḍhapiṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjāmi, bhagavato sāsanaṃ manasi kareyyaṃ, bahu vata me kataṃ assā'ti.
tena hi, bhaṇe, yo bāhiresu janapadesu āyo sañjāyati tato upaḍḍhaṃ antepure pavesetha, upaḍḍhaṃ tatth'eva dānaṃ detha samaṇa-brāhmaṇa-kapaṇ'addhika-vanibbaka-yācakānan'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, upaḍḍham'idaṃ, bhante, brahmacariyaṃ, yadidaṃ, kalyāṇamittatā kalyāṇasahāyatā kalyāṇasampavaṅkatā'ti.

evaṃ, bhante'ti kho, bhikkhave, abhibhū bhikkhu sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānena'pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, adissamānena'pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānena'pi heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi, dissamānena'pi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi.

15593.commentary: (VINt) yassa dvīsu bhāgesu eko channo, eko acchanno, idaṃ upaḍḍhacchannaṃ nāma sen'āsanaṃ.

15594.commentary: (DNa) upaḍḍhapathan'ti yojanaṃ ce, no antare bhaveyya, gotamo aḍḍhayojanaṃ, ahaṃ aḍḍhayojanaṃ. esa nayo aḍḍhayojan'ādīsu. ekapadavāram'pi atikkamma gacchato jayo bhavissati, anāgacchato parājayo'ti.

examples.text: ñāṇavādo kho pana ñāṇavādena arahati uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ dassetuṃ. samaṇo gotamo upaḍḍhapathaṃ āgaccheyya, aham'pi upaḍḍhapathaṃ gaccheyyaṃ. te tattha ubho'pi uttarimanussadhammā iddhipāṭihāriyaṃ kareyyāma.
